A guided tour on a made-up direction

A Guided tour in the Presentation menu, under Master presentation. It opens a made-up direction full screen and walks the room through its slides: the slide is dimmed, one part is lit, and a card says what it is. No real direction or team is shown. These are real screenshots of the build, at El Abd's Q3 point in the year.

1. Presentation → Guided tour

Under Master presentation, for the same people who see Master presentation. One press opens the example full screen with the first card already showing. The picker inside Master presentation and the button on a real direction's cover are gone.

2. The tour, stop by stop

The key measures and tactics slides each open on the whole slide, clear, then light their parts one by one, then close on the whole slide clear again. After the Note, the key measures light one whole line, the one furthest behind, the way the tactics light their delayed row. Fourteen lit stops, four clear views, and a closing card. On the tactics, YTD actual and Progress come before Delayed. The cards' text now grows with the screen, as the slides do: about 25px on a 1920 projector (it was 16px), 21px at this mockup's size, 18px on a laptop. Click a stop, use the buttons, or the arrow keys here, the same keys the presenter uses in the room.

    3. The made-up direction

    EX001 Growing the Restaurant Business, presented by "Head of Restaurants". It is built fresh each time it opens and is never saved, so it is in nobody's plan and never reaches the database. Its cover says the figures are made up. Its tactics slide has no Owner or Collabs. columns; real decks keep whatever the Columns switch says.

    LineWhat it shows
    Restaurant salesNeeds attention, 82%. A yearly total, so "due" is the share of 120M EGP owed by now. Note: two new branches opened a quarter late.
    Average spend per guestOn track, 105%.
    Delivery share of salesOff track, 44%. Note: our own delivery app slipped.
    Food cost as a share of salesOn track, 97%. Lower is better.
    Open two new branchesCompleted.
    Launch delivery through our own appIn progress and DELAYED. Note: payment gateway approval pending.
    Refresh the menu around best sellersIn progress, on track.
    Family-meal campaign for the holidaysNot due yet.

    The tactics' quarters are set from where the cycle stands, so the same mix shows at Q3 today and at any other review point. In a Q4 review nothing can still be Not due, so that line drops out.

    4. How it behaves in the room

    ActWhat happens
    → or the clickerLights the next part. On a clear view, brings the spotlight in. After the closing clear view, turns the slide.
    Click on the dimSame as Next.
    ←Back one part.
    FinishOn the closing card: closes the example and returns to the platform, ready for Master presentation.
    G or the ×Ends the tour and stays on the slide, so you can talk to it. G starts it again.
    EscLeaves full screen and the example, back to the platform.
